Name: Tamersdew - Tamers12345 NPC replacers (Aesthetic only)
Author: Carabarabonanza
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Have you ever wanted to inject more of Tamers12345's glory directly into your veins? Well for now you can settle for installing this mod into Stardew! This mod replaces Stardew characters with characters from his three series Sonic Underground, MLP and Dandy's World

This is the start of what will hopefully be a series of mods so feel free to leave suggestions for what other Tamers characters could replace the Stardew ones. If things go well enough itd be fun to add dialogue changes, different liked gifts, new events ect.

I give full permission to use this mod in your own project as long as I'm credited 👍 God knows this arts gonna take forever so if yall wanna take a swing at dialogue overhalls and whatnot Id be happy to see it.

Heres a list of planned replacements so far, I may or may not make multiple portraits for the same stardew character or even adapt some portraits to fit other characters/mods. Feel free to let me know what you think.

If youd like to check out my other projects, my art or are considering supporting me [url=https://carabarabonanza.carrd.co/]all my info is on my carrd![/url]
